g.text: D1..D5: SK6805-EC3210R side-firing RGB, chained D1 -> D5 in the order the maker's firmware expects. TP1 = chain out (more LEDs), TP2 = UPDI programming pad, TP3 = GND pad.

g.desc: D1..D5: SK6805-EC3210R side-firing RGB, chained D1 -> D5 in the order the maker's firmware expects. TP1 = chain out (more LEDs), TP2 = UPDI programming pad, TP3 = GND pad.

g.text: JP1 (the maker's JP2): pads 1-2 bridged by copper = LEDs driven by the ATtiny (PA6). Cut the bridge and solder 2-3 = LEDs driven by the badge on SAO GPIO1.

g.desc: JP1 (the maker's JP2): pads 1-2 bridged by copper = LEDs driven by the ATtiny (PA6). Cut the bridge and solder 2-3 = LEDs driven by the badge on SAO GPIO1.

g.text: No I2C pull-ups on the add-on (the maker's R1/R2 10k were removed; the badge provides them). SAO GPIO2 is not connected (the maker's UPDI-on-GPIO2 jumper JP1 was removed).

g.desc: No I2C pull-ups on the add-on (the maker's R1/R2 10k were removed; the badge provides them). SAO GPIO2 is not connected (the maker's UPDI-on-GPIO2 jumper JP1 was removed).

g.text: D6 is the series cell diode required by docs/standard.md section 3: the ATtiny is wired to SAO SDA/SCL, so nothing may push current into the CR2032.

g.desc: D6 is the series cell diode required by docs/standard.md section 3: the ATtiny is wired to SAO SDA/SCL, so nothing may push current into the CR2032.

g.text: Power: SW1 common (pin 3) is VLOAD. Position SAO = badge 3.3 V (pin 1), middle = OFF (pin 2, unconnected), BAT = coin cell through D6 (pin 4).

g.desc: Power: SW1 common (pin 3) is VLOAD. Position SAO = badge 3.3 V (pin 1), middle = OFF (pin 2, unconnected), BAT = coin cell through D6 (pin 4).
